14728|b050140a.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
14728|b050140a.text:
Hail brother... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.

We $r have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of $r everywhere in helping us out!

3008|b0fd68db.name: Mak
3008|b0fd68db.text: Cleanse your hands before you begin any project. Staining the leather with blood or dirt would take away from its natural beauty.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3483|aa3c8600.name: Jahan Hawkwing
3483|aa3c8600.text: The Barrens, with its hot sun and hostile denizens, is the perfect place to test your strength and fortitude.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

6362-complete.name: Ahanu
6362-complete.text:
Ah, a new bundle of hides.  I will get to work on these immediately!

Thank you, brother.  You have done me a great service.  Here are some coins to pay for your time and travel costs.
6362-complete.title: Ride to Thunder Bluff

6362-progress.name: Ahanu
6362-progress.text: There is dust on your shoulders that must be from the Barrens.  You have spoken with my friend Jahan?
6362-progress.title: Ride to Thunder Bluff

6363-accept.name: Ahanu
6363-accept.text:
I have prepared leather goods for Jahan to sell at the Crossroads.  Will you bring them to him?

If you have already been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master, then you can fly one of our Thunder Bluff wind riders back to him.

Take the leather goods to Tal, our wind rider master in Thunder Bluff, and speak with him to arrange transport to the Crossroads.
6363-accept.title: Tal the Wind Rider Master

6363-complete.name: Tal
6363-complete.text: You need to take this to the Crossroads, eh?  That's not a problem.  If you've already been there and spoken to Devrak, then you can take one of my wind riders back to him.
6363-complete.title: Tal the Wind Rider Master

6363-progress.name: Tal
6363-progress.text: Greetings, $c.  What can I do for you?
6363-progress.title: Tal the Wind Rider Master

6364-accept.name: Tal
6364-accept.text:
In order to fly to a town, you must have already been there and spoken with the wind rider master of that town.  You have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so for a small fee you can take a wind rider to him from here.

Speak with me again when you are ready.  Once at the Crossroads, you can then deliver the leather goods to Jahan Hawkwing.
6364-accept.title: Return to Jahan

6364-complete.name: Jahan Hawkwing
6364-complete.text:
Ahanu sent me finished products?  Very good.  There are many hunters and adventurers in the Crossroads now and business is lively.  I am sure I'll sell these goods very soon.

Thank you for all your efforts, $N.  I am in your debt.
6364-complete.title: Return to Jahan

6364-progress.name: Jahan Hawkwing
6364-progress.text: $N, you are back from Thunder Bluff?  Did you deliver the hides to Ahanu?
6364-progress.title: Return to Jahan

845-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-complete.text:
Not bad, $N.  Those zhevra hold a lot of strength in their legs.  A sharp kick from them can knock even a $r on its haunches!

It looks like you have some strength in you too.  Are you ready for a real challenge?
845-complete.title: The Zhevra

845-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-progress.text: How many zhevra have you slain?
845-progress.title: The Zhevra

848-complete.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-complete.text:
Ah, yes.  These are good specimens.  Potent.

I am Forsaken, and we honor our contracts.  Here is your reward, $N.
848-complete.title: Fungal Spores

848-progress.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-progress.text: Do you have the spores, $N?  There is a concoction I must send to my associate in Thunder Bluff, which requires the spores...
848-progress.title: Fungal Spores

869-complete.name: Gazrog
869-complete.text:
You got rid of the raptors!

Thank you, $N.  You are a $c of worth.
869-complete.title: Raptor Thieves

870-complete.name: Tonga Runetotem
870-complete.text:
You found a fissure in the earth, with gases bubbling from it?  Strange.  This may be an answer to our questions, but we cannot yet be sure.

But it is a clue.  And I am grateful that you found it.
870-complete.title: The Forgotten Pools

872-accept.name: Thork
872-accept.text:
One of my scouts witnessed an attack on a caravan from Durotar, $N. The culprits are indeed the Razormane tribe of quilboars. One of the quilboars in particular is leading the raids: Kreenig Snarlsnout. He was seen northeast of here, just south of the road from Durotar. If the threat is to be ended, then Kreenig must die.

To be sure the attacks cease, though, I say we add insult to their injury. Kill Kreenig along with more of their tribe, and return to me when you have his tusk.
872-accept.title: The Disruption Ends

877-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
877-accept.text:
Like the one you found at the Forgotten Pools, there may be fissures at the other oases in the Barrens.  If so, then perhaps the fissures are the oases' source of life.

We must test this.

Here, take these seeds.  They are dead and infertile, but take them to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast.  If there is a fissure there, then place the seeds within it...and observe.
877-accept.title: The Stagnant Oasis

881-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
881-accept.text:
Whitemist, Echeyakee in the $R tongue, is the king of the savannah cats.  He hunts with such stealth, they say he's like a thin, white mist on the earth.  And he kills so fast his prey have no time for fear, or pain.

The $R say he is both mercy and death.

You will learn if that's true, for I now set you on the path to hunt Echeyakee.  His lair is northeast of the Crossroads, among the bones of giant Kodo

Go.  Blow this horn when you reach his lair.  Blow the horn, and he will come.
881-accept.title: Echeyakee

903-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-accept.text:
Now it's time to go after something that really bites.  The prowlers of the Barrens are a tough breed.  Tough, resourceful, sly... and deadly.  You'll find them among the tall grasses.  You'll find many to the southwest of the Crossroads.

Be wary as you hunt them, $N, or you may find yourself no longer the predator, but instead the prey.
903-accept.title: Prowlers of the Barrens

903-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-complete.text: Ah, I see you've been busy, lurking in the grasses and hunting prowlers.  Do you think, then, it is time to face a champion among them?
903-complete.title: Prowlers of the Barrens

903-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-progress.text: How goes your hunt, $N?  Have you found the prowlers?
903-progress.title: Prowlers of the Barrens
